notes.title: Title Update Y6S3.3
notes.notes:
[h1]PATCH NOTES[/h1]

[h2]Stretch Goals – Season Pass Extension (Limited-Time Event)[/h2]

Stretch Goals is a new limited-time feature that extends the Season Pass beyond Tier 100, giving you additional rewards to chase after finishing the main progression.

Available from May 6 to May 27, this event adds a special extra page (Page 11) to the Season Pass with 10 looping reward tiers. Once you reach Tier 110, the loop restarts at Tier 101 - letting you keep earning rewards as long as the event is active.

Progress is earned through standard Season Pass XP sources, including Journey, Priority Objectives, Weekly Projects, Manhunt Scouts, and activities like Missions, Descent, and Conflict. However, the 5X Season XP event only applies up to Tier 100 - progress in Stretch Goals follows the normal XP rate.

[b]Guaranteed Rewards:[/b]
[list]
[*] Reward 1: Seasonal Items
[*] Reward 2: Seasonal Items
[*] Reward 3: Materials used for crafting/upgrading seasonal items
[/list]
[b]Bonus Rewards (Chance-Based)
[/b]
Each cache also has a chance to drop the following bonus rewards:

[list]

Includes:
[list]
[*] Carapace Exotic Weapon Skin

[/list]

Includes:
[list]

[/list]

[h2]OTHER[/h2]
